_why: Large pastes use host-owned files with bounded restoration. Length limits use UTF-16 code units so editor and host agree for supplementary Unicode characters.

storage.deleteOnRemove: Only draft-owned or already-pending-removal files are deleted. Released files retained by submitted or queued content remain readable.

restore.selection: Use the current editor selection when the owned read completes, expanding intersected atoms.
restore.text: Insert literal editable text without resolving stale quote ranges.
restore.ownership: Reject a retired input or removed card; ordinary typing or caret movement does not retire the read.
restore.history: Document Undo/Redo affects inserted text without recreating the consumed card.

remove.history: After document history is exhausted, platform Undo/Redo restores or removes the exact attachment entry in its original relative position.
remove.cleanup: Renew expiry after Undo/Redo; delete only when removal remains applied and no draft retains the file.
remove.pending: Keep an undoable pending object through successful settlement; failed settlement retires its removal action.
remove.consumed: Restoring a card into editable text retires earlier removal actions for that card.
remove.ownership: Navigation, draft replacement or submission prevents old attachment actions from changing newer input.
